message: Fixed P2 cross-project NotifyAgent activity bug from review _reviews/e84a2674ec01c4fd39834af387512797. Commit efe769e06b34451e007198a050d227947fd83410 pushed on feat/incremental-agent-instructions. Client now treats foreign NotifyAgent destination dispatch as non-local activity: no Ready->Working activation, destination last-seen, or unrelated Working-turn guidance; source sender AgentInbox verification/activation and durable destination notification remain intact. Added true two-project separate-ledger regression using same Owner ID, with positive local-notify control and activity log checks. Full Release: Client 392/392; Server 95/95; git diff --check clean. Branch not merged or deployed. Ready for independent re-review.
